text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with y.
Plate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
PublishedIn(y, z) ::: y is published in year z.

Premises:
∀x (Plate(x) → FromIstanbul(x) if and only if BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All plates from Istanbul begin with 34, and only those plates beginning with 34 are from Istanbul.
¬FromIstanbul(x) if and only if ¬BeginsWith(x, 34) ::: Plates not from Istanbul do not begin with 34.
FromIstanbul(Joe's plate) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(Tom's plate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.

Conclusion:
BeginsWith(Joe's plate, 34) ::: Joe's license plate begins with the number 34.
